name: declared-include-admits-generated-tree
purpose: A package whose tsconfig explicitly includes a generated-looking `lib/**/*.js` tree and excludes `src/`. The declaration decides the universe: lib is source and src is not.
exercises: an explicit tsconfig include is authoritative over what a path looks like
a generated-looking tree is admitted because the repository declared it, not because the directory name was guessed
files outside the declared include are excluded

inspiredBy.originalBehaviour: `tsconfig.json` lists `lib/**/*.js` in `include` with `allowJs`/`checkJs`, and 640 of 765 modules live in that committed, generated tree. A repository that names a tree in its own TypeScript program has declared it; withholding it would be the silent narrowing ADR-0047 forbids.
